evidence.reason: At line 238 the guard accepts a candidate only when path.relative(canonical, candidate) begins with '..'. For canonical '/repo' and candidate '/repo/..tools/git', path.relative returns '..tools/git', which starts with '..' but is a descendant of the checkout, not a parent traversal. The guard therefore lets an executable under a checkout-controlled directory such as /repo/..tools/git pass as trusted Git; the subsequent lstat/identity check records that same selected file and does not exclude it. This is an implementation defect in the intended rejection of checkout-owned Git paths; exact component checking is needed.
